facts.why: The Wikipedia production section calls it the film's Pandora Theater, the condemned theater where Nick shows the Jack Slater films.

vibe.verdict: A bold neon cinema with the magic ticket and Whiskers, but Arnold's Hamlet, the glass eye and Death are missing.
missing: Arnold as Hamlet in Danny's daydream ("Big mistake")
Death stepping out of The Seventh Seal
Danny snuffing a lit fuse with his popcorn bucket
ideas: Swap "Times Square knishes" for "Hamlet's cigar chocolates" with the line "Big mistake".
Swap "Movie world pepperoni" note for "Benedict's glass eye olives".
Swap "Matinee ice cream sundae" for "Ice cream truck special, hold the explosion".
Swap the popcorn note for Danny putting out the fuse with his bucket.
